title: Hall of Unstable Magic
name: scene_magic_hall
scene_summary: A huge round hall of polished black stone with glowing lines of energy moving under its surface, four raised circular platforms joined to the floor by narrow stone bridges, tall runed obelisks round the wall, a stretch of floor missing in the south where things hang weightless, and a mirror wall across the north end.
render_details: Glass-smooth black stone with coloured light moving beneath it, thin threads of violet, cyan and gold energy, pale grey stone platforms and narrow bridges, tall dark obelisks cut with glowing runes, torn floor edges over an empty void, a full-height mirrored surface reflecting the room

rooms.label: The Rotunda
rooms.description: One enormous round hall with a floor of perfectly smooth black stone, glowing lines of energy running slowly beneath its surface in complex patterns. It is one open space with nothing built across it except what is described separately.

annotations.label: The Great Crystal
annotations.description: An enormous many-faceted crystal seen from straight above, turning slowly over the middle of the hall, with thin threads of violet, cyan and gold energy running out of it in every direction across the floor and away along the walls, and a bright circle of its light thrown onto the black stone directly beneath it

annotations.label: North Platform
annotations.description: A round platform of pale grey stone standing a step above the floor, its edge a clean circle, joined to the floor by one narrow stone bridge

annotations.label: South Platform
annotations.description: A round platform of pale grey stone standing a step above the floor, its edge a clean circle, joined to the floor by one narrow stone bridge

annotations.label: West Platform
annotations.description: A round platform of pale grey stone standing a step above the floor, its edge a clean circle, joined to the floor by one narrow stone bridge

annotations.label: East Platform
annotations.description: A round platform of pale grey stone standing a step above the floor, its edge a clean circle, joined to the floor by one narrow stone bridge

annotations.label: Runed Obelisks
annotations.description: Dark stone obelisks set at even intervals along the wall, seen from straight above as rectangular black tops with hard shadows beside them, each one cut with ancient runes, some of the runes burning steadily and others flaring on and off

annotations.label: Weightless Zone
annotations.description: A stretch where the floor is simply gone, its torn edges dropping into empty black nothing, with loose stones, broken fragments and beads of water hanging motionless in the air above the gap

annotations.label: Mirror Wall
annotations.description: A band of mirrored surface set flush into the north wall from side to side, seen from straight above as a bright reflective strip along the top of the wall, throwing back a reflection of the hall that does not quite match it

annotations.label: Energy Lines
annotations.description: Bright thin lines of coloured energy running through the black stone just below its surface, curving into complicated geometric patterns and meeting at the middle of the hall
